sources.description: Arizona started the season on a good note with a 35-7 victory over in-state foe NAU. Pro Football Focus gave the Wildcats an overall mark of 80.6. The offense was graded at 77.9 and the defense was given a 74.8 grade. The best aspect of Arizona’s performance was the pass blocking which received a 88.2 […]
